query: World Scholars Cup requirements to advance to Global Rounds

results.title: World Scholar's Cup - Wikipedia
results.snippet: The World Scholar’s Cup is an annual international academic program that features essay writing, debates and quizzes to address real world scenarios. More than 50,000 students from over 67 countries participate every year.

results.title: The World Scholar's Cup · FAQ
results.snippet: As the World Scholar's Cup is built around teams of three, two-person teams will be required to reach the same threshold as three-person teams to receive berths to the Global Round and the Tournament of Champions.

results.title: World Scholar's Cup | Must Know Guide | Immerse Education
results.snippet: The World Scholar’s Cup holds regional and global rounds in person at various international locations, including cities in the US, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. Some events have offered virtual participation options recently. Students worldwide can enter by registering a team.

results.title: World Scholar's Cup Coaching 2026 | How to Qualify | DSDC
results.snippet: Students who advance to Global Rounds move into an intensive cohort with expanded content review, advanced writing practice, and higher-stakes mock rounds. Students heading to the Tournament of Champions at Yale get additional one-on-one coaching.

results.title: The World Scholar's Cup Tournament of Champions at Yale University
results.snippet: Academic requirement. Must have qualified through a Global Round of the World Scholar's Cup. Prerequisites.Teams must qualify from a Regional Round to advance to a Global Round, and then from a Global Round to the Tournament of Champions.
